description: List a workspace's Foundry workflows: graphs of steps Foundry runs as their owner when a schedule fires or a sync, load, upload or draft ends, each with its newest run. Specs are left out: helix_foundry_get_workflow reads one.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_list_workflows

status.description: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled or skipped (never started: error says why).

output.description: Untrusted: what it gave (summary, answer, count, branch, result).

trigger.description: Untrusted: what fired it, its kind and the ids of the work it found.

use_cases.description: The ontologies it used, each with the use case run that records it and its verdict: in a get only.

never_called.description: The use case run finished without a read or question of the ontology, so it isn't assessed.

verdict.description: Once assessed: essential, helpful, marginal, unused or misleading.

spec.description: Untrusted workflow spec, its graph. Left out of a list.

status.description: needs_approval (its owner approves its spec in Foundry, at url, before it runs: new, or changed), active (it runs when its trigger fires) or paused (it runs only by hand).

use_cases.description: The ontologies its runs use: Foundry records each run that uses one in a use case of that ontology (helix_foundry_get_use_case_run reads its runs), whose assessments say how much the ontology helped.

gaps.description: Untrusted: what the ontology lacked, as the newest assessed run named it.

untracked.description: Why its runs go unrecorded: workflows_full, the ontology holding 100 use cases.

title: List Foundry workflows
